description: Use this when the user wants to message another TraydStar member, for example to ask about a listing or agree on terms before proposing a trade. Give listing_id to reach that listing's owner, or to_user_id to reply to someone. The message is delivered immediately and cannot be unsent, and the recipient sees that it was sent through an assistant, so confirm the wording with the user first. Until the recipient replies, at most 3 messages can be sent to them.

listing_id.description: The listing the message is about; reaches its owner if to_user_id is omitted

name: send_message
title: Send a message
